meta.name: dag-library
meta.description: Stores a DAG definition once and re-runs it by name, instead of pasting the definition into every run. Use when the user wants to save a DAG, run a saved one, or schedule the same multi-agent graph repeatedly.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 保存一次多智能体任务流程，之后按名称即可重跑。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你常要反复执行同一套智能体协作流程，希望保存一次就能按名重跑。
copy.tagline_en: Save once, then rerun multi-agent jobs by name.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you keep recreating the same multi-agent workflow and need a saved way to rerun it.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会把多智能体 DAG 定义存成库里的 JSON 文件,之后按名字加载并重新运行,不用每次把定义粘一遍。定义里的 {{key}}、{{date}} 等占位符在加载时自动填好。
howto.when: 当你想保存一个 DAG、按名字重跑已保存的图,或反复调度同一张多智能体图时触发。新写一张图不归它管,那要先看 mass-ulw。

say.text: 把这个 DAG 存成 nightly-audit,放到项目库
按名字运行 nightly-audit,后缀用 20260818
say.note: key 变成该后缀,可幂等复用
key 不变,复用上一次的结果

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude stores a multi-agent DAG definition as a JSON file in a library and later loads and re-runs it by name instead of pasting the definition each time. Placeholders like {{key}} and {{date}} are filled in at load time.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you want to save a DAG, re-run a saved one by name, or schedule the same multi-agent graph repeatedly. Authoring a brand-new graph is out of scope; read mass-ulw first.

say_en.text: Save this DAG as nightly-audit in the project library
say_en.note: Writes to .omo/dags and runs it once to confirm
Key becomes that suffix, so it can be reused idempotently

say_en.text: Run nightly-audit with an empty suffix
say_en.note: Key stays the same, reusing the previous result
